subject: modifying parameter values in a fitted mirt model

messages.author: 2d98f40c09e307a5
messages.subject: modifying parameter values in a fitted mirt model
parts:
I am using 3pl irt, and have become concerned by the bias and variance deflation in predicted scores (abilities) (see Zhang, J. M., M. G. Xie, X. L. Song, and T. Lu. 2011. INVESTIGATING THE IMPACT OF UNCERTAINTY ABOUT ITEM PARAMETERS ON ABILITY ESTIMATION. Psychometrika 76:97-118.).  I would like to bias correct the item parameter estimates in a fitted model before I use fscores to predict the abilities.  Basically, I need to do something like inverting the mod2values function.  Has anybody written a function for poking values into a fitted model object?

Thanks Mark L. Taper

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: modifying parameter values in a fitted mirt model
parts:
I'm sure it's possible, but I don't know anyone who has done it. Plus it seems rather computationally intensive in that it requires bias estimates of the item parameters via bootstrap/jack-knife.  

Phil
